relations.evidence: U Paṇḍita began practicing Vipassana under the guidance of Mahāsi Sayādaw beginning in 1950.

relations.subject: U Paṇḍita
relations.evidence: In 1955, he left his position as a teacher of scriptural studies to become a meditation teacher at the Mahāsi Meditation Center.

relations.subject: U Paṇḍita
relations.evidence: Soon after Mahasi Sayādaw died in 1982, U Paṇḍita became the guiding teacher (Ovādacariya) of the Mahasi Meditation Center. In 1991, he left that position
